converter_desc: Powered by Gotenberg Chromium. Convert markup and documents with pixel-perfect accuracy.
assets_desc: If your HTML references local images (e.g., logo.png), upload them here so the engine can link them.
margins_desc: Set to 0 if your HTML already has internal padding.
toast_fetch_failed: Could not fetch file from storage.
toast_warning_html: Warning: The selected file might not be standard HTML.
toast_import_failed: Failed to import file from storage. Ensure it exists.
toast_transpiling: Gotenberg Engine is transpiling your document...
toast_unexpected: An unexpected error occurred during conversion.
tour_header_desc: This tool utilizes headless Chromium to transpile HTML documents into pixel-perfect PDFs.
tour_step1_desc: Upload an HTML file, pull one securely from the cloud File Manager, or write HTML code directly into the built-in IDE.
tour_step2_desc: If your HTML code references local files like "logo.png" or "style.css", upload them here so the engine can render them.
tour_step3_desc: Configure the paper size, orientation, and dictate whether the engine should print background colors.
tour_generate_desc: Click this to package your HTML and assets, send them to the internal rendering engine, and generate the resulting PDF.
toast_saved_cloud: PDF securely saved to File Manager!
toast_save_failed: Failed to save PDF to the cloud.
